column1: # Hand-declared corrections to the human movie scene annotations.
# The .xlsx masters under stimuli/movies/movie_annotations/ are raw stimulus
# assets and are never edited in place -- a silent repair inside a parser is
# invisible provenance. Every fix lives here instead, is applied by
# parse_movie_annotations.py, and is REFUSED if the source no longer holds
# `old_mss` (which is what happens once a master is re-exported with the fix
# baked in: the parser then tells you to delete the row).
# Lives in the repo rather than beside the data so that git carries who
# changed which cell, when, and why.
# Times are m.ss, matching the source cells (2.35 = 2 min 35 s = 155 s).
# status: verified (checked against neighbouring segments) | provisional (a
# guess that reproduces the file's own timing convention; revisit).
